## Urgency distribution

Counted against two anchors: **today** and the fixed judging anchor **2026-09-07**. `≤7d` / `≤30d` are inclusive windows starting at the anchor and **`≤7d` is a subset of `≤30d`**; `30일 초과` is a key date further out; `지남` is a key date already behind the anchor; `날짜 없음` is an exposable event whose countdown date is 추후결정 or not rendered. `≤30d + 30일 초과 + 지남 + 날짜 없음 = 계`.

**anchor = today (2026-08-21)**

| | ≤7d | ≤30d | 30일 초과 | 지남 | 날짜 없음 | 계 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| R1 | 3 | 5 | 9 | 34 | 2 | 50 |
| R2 | 8 | 28 | 338 | 56 | 0 | 422 |
| R3 | 1 | 1 | 9 | 4 | 2 | 16 |
| **계** | 12 | 34 | 356 | 94 | 4 | 488 |

**anchor = 2026-09-07 (심사 기준일)**

| | ≤7d | ≤30d | 30일 초과 | 지남 | 날짜 없음 | 계 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| R1 | 1 | 8 | 2 | 38 | 2 | 50 |
| R2 | 7 | 33 | 322 | 67 | 0 | 422 |
| R3 | 0 | 2 | 7 | 5 | 2 | 16 |
| **계** | 8 | 43 | 331 | 110 | 4 | 488 |

**`지남` does not mean the same thing in every type.** For ① it is a right that has already lapsed (the 매매기간 closed) and for ③ a deadline that has passed — both are history. For ② a past 전환청구 개시일 means the window is **already open**: the dilution is live right now, not over. Whether and how the board shows each of those is a design question (R2), not a data one.
